definitions.explanation: A male parent. A more formal or objective term than {父|ちち} or お{父|とう}さん.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{父親|ちちおや}は{医者|いしゃ}だ。
{父親|ちちおや}として、{子|こ}どもの{将来|しょうらい}が{心配|しんぱい}だ。
examples.english: As a father, I worry about my children's future.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{父親|ちちおや}に{似|に}ている。

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{父親|ちちおや}: Formal, objective term for 'father' used when discussing fathers in general or describing family relationships
・{父|ちち}: Humble term used to refer to one's own father when speaking to others
・お{父|とう}さん: Polite/familiar term used to address one's father or refer to someone else's father
・パパ: Casual, childish term for 'daddy'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{父親|ちちおや}として (as a father)
・{父親|ちちおや}になる (to become a father)
・{父親|ちちおや}らしい (fatherly)
